name: RC-B10-0471/2025 – After § 12 – Am 13/1
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on renewing the EU-Africa partnership: building common priorities ahead of the Angola Summit
part_text: 12a. Recalls that Christians are the most persecuted religious community in the world; notes with particular concern the situation of Christians in the Sahel region as well as in Nigeria and northern Mozambique; calls on, in particular, the Nigerian Government to ensure that the Christian community is safe from violence and persecution;
